dct_description_sm:
This data shows the spatial extent of surface disturbance mapping projects completed by GIS contractors on behalf of Environment Yukon. Within these polygons, features were digitized using high resolution satellite imagery and orthophotos; outside these polygons, disturbance mapping is either incomplete or non-existent.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/en/statistics-and-data/mapping/explore-map-data-using-geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital [map](https://yukon.ca/en/maps) data collection.

For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
